description: List saved RDP servers together with their runtime state, live session_id, actual connection_state, desktop view and input-lock/clipboard status. state is foreground or background while connecting/connected, otherwise closed. view is non-null whenever a desktop page remains open, including a disconnected page; its location is sidebar or window, not OS focus. saved:false retains orphan connections/windows whose profile was removed externally. Does not connect, open pages, or return passwords. Use the stable profile_id for all operations. session_id is informational and changes on reconnection. Profile fields use snake_case and include revision for saved profiles. Use profile for configuration and control for runtime changes.

Read or modify saved server configuration. action=get requires profile_id; add requires changes.host and uses defaults for omitted fields; update requires profile_id, latest revision and nonempty changes, preserving unspecified fields and the password; delete requires profile_id and latest revision. Get/add/update return the profile with snake_case fields and profile_id; list returns the same fields. Running, open or edited profiles cannot be modified or deleted. Passwords and certificate trust use the UI; passwords are never returned. This tool does not connect or change runtime state. Never blindly repeat a write after a lost receipt.

desktop_width.description: Fixed desktop width in pixels. Defaults to 1280 for new profiles. Width × height must not exceed 16,777,216 pixels; applies to the next new connection.

desktop_height.description: Fixed desktop height in pixels. Defaults to 800 for new profiles. Width × height must not exceed 16,777,216 pixels; applies to the next new connection.

clipboard_support.description: Negotiate clipboard support on the next connection. Default false. Runtime clipboard sync remains off until explicitly enabled in the desktop toolbar.

disable_mouse_animation.description: Disable local cursor animation. Defaults to false; does not change remote input or screenshots.

adaptive_window.description: Adapt remote resolution to the detached window. Default false.

adaptive_sidebar.description: Adapt remote resolution to the sidebar. Default false.

description: Control a server runtime by stable profile_id from list; never changes saved configuration. Omitted fields stay unchanged; supply at least one operation. state=foreground connects/reuses and shows the desktop (not OS focus); optional location moves it without saving the preference, otherwise preserve the current location or use the saved default. background connects/reuses and closes the desktop, keeping the connection. closed stops the connection and closes even a disconnected desktop; it cannot combine with any other operation. ui_locked=true blocks local UI input while tools remain usable; false unlocks. reset_input=true explicitly releases ordinary/modifier keys, clears Caps/Num/Scroll/Kana toggles and releases left/middle/right mouse buttons at the last known pointer position; it interrupts pending input with RDP_INPUT_RESET and is never automatic. Without state, lock/reset require an already-connected server and never reconnect. Order: connect if requested, lock/unlock, reset, update presentation. All parameters are checked before effects; operations for one server run in order. Returns ok, actual state/connection_state/view, and applied receipts. applied lists confirmed steps only; a missing receipt does not prove no effect. On failure, inspect failed_step/error and applied; earlier effects are not rolled back. Password/certificate requirements need the UI. Reset acceptance is not remote completion. Calls stay bound to their selected connection; connections and locks survive pages/conversations, locks end on disconnection.

Capture the remote desktop of an existing RDP session as a PNG image, even with no desktop page open. Returns desktop pixel dimensions and frame, cursor and input timestamps. The image uses original desktop coordinates without scaling. Cursor is included when its position is known unless include_cursor is false. A screenshot observes the current received frame; it does not confirm that preceding remote actions have completed. Use list to obtain a server profile ID. Target the stable profile_id returned by list. Requires an existing connected server; never connects implicitly. The call stays bound to the connection selected at dispatch and cannot continue on a replacement connection.

save.description: Also save the PNG in the host-managed temporary directory. Returns saved_path on success or save_error; the image is still returned. Files may be removed by host cleanup.

description: Send ordered desktop input exactly as requested. press(key) sends down, holds 50 ms, then up; hotkey(keys) sends downs in array order, holds 50 ms, then ups in reverse. Repeat by listing actions again. Use uppercase key names without separators: A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, CTRL, SHIFT, ALT, WIN, ENTER, ESC, SPACE, TAB, BACKSPACE, LEFT/UP/RIGHT/DOWN, PAGEDOWN, PAGEUP, HOME, END, INSERT, DELETE, or uppercase browser KeyboardEvent.code names such as ALTRIGHT. Raw key(code 1-127, extended, down) and button(left/right/middle, down) send only that event; no automatic release or held-key tracking. A down can span calls, screenshots and page moves; send an explicit up when intended. press/hotkey always send their ups, including for previously held keys. Mouse move/button/wheel use original screenshot pixels; wheel delta is -256..255, nonzero. Top-level interval_ms (0-1000, default 50) is the gap between completed actions; 0 is valid. text(text) sends Unicode characters as supplied, including supplementary characters, in batches of at most 8 Unicode characters with 50 ms settling after each batch, including the last. Text is not trimmed, newline-converted or given an appended Enter. Each text action accepts 1-4096 Unicode characters; the whole actions array must fit 12000 UTF-8 bytes when JSON-serialized. A whole text is one action for interval_ms; 0 does not disable internal text pacing. The execution deadline is 300 seconds, including all actions, pacing and delays. After 10 seconds Anas may return a background call ID: wait for that same call, do not resend input. Use a following press ENTER or hotkey CTRL+ENTER when intended; do not rely on text control characters to act as physical keys. Application support varies; no clipboard or keyboard-layout fallback. The receipt confirms queue acceptance, not remote completion. Concurrent input returns RDP_INPUT_BUSY. After dispatch, caller cancellation does not interrupt the requested sequence; the original execution deadline or a send failure stops remaining steps without extra releases or rollback and does not stop the connection or plugin backend. Disconnection also stops pending input. A deadline error may follow partial input. An explicit control(reset_input=true) interrupts a pending sequence with RDP_INPUT_RESET. Inspect after partial failure or a lost receipt; never blindly replay. UI and tools share the remote keyboard; use control(ui_locked=true/false) explicitly when needed. Target the stable profile_id returned by list. Requires an existing connected server; never connects implicitly. The call stays bound to the connection selected at dispatch and cannot continue on a replacement connection.

interval_ms.description: Milliseconds between complete actions (default 50). 0 disables inter-action spacing but retains press/hotkey holds and internal text pacing.

text.description: Unicode text sent unchanged. Whole actions JSON is limited to 12000 UTF-8 bytes, including escaping. Use press/hotkey for explicit keyboard operations.

key.description: Use an uppercase key name without separators: A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, CTRL, SHIFT, ALT, WIN, ENTER, ESC, SPACE, TAB, BACKSPACE, LEFT/UP/RIGHT/DOWN, PAGEDOWN, PAGEUP, HOME, END, INSERT, DELETE, or uppercase browser KeyboardEvent.code names such as ALTRIGHT.

items.description: Use an uppercase key name without separators: A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, CTRL, SHIFT, ALT, WIN, ENTER, ESC, SPACE, TAB, BACKSPACE, LEFT/UP/RIGHT/DOWN, PAGEDOWN, PAGEUP, HOME, END, INSERT, DELETE, or uppercase browser KeyboardEvent.code names such as ALTRIGHT.
